note: Templates rekeyed onto the app's EXISTING fallback-hook/* keys so importing UPDATES the app's real templates instead of a parallel fallback-template/* set. natal-placement was split into you.natal-placement (sign) + you.natal-house-placement (house) to match the app's section structure. Rows with isNewKey=true are additions the app must create and wire to the matching section/selector (retrograde placement, retrograde-ingress, aspect row, ruler section, chart-ruler section, synthesis section). Double-brace {{lowercase}} slots. Fill per tldrastro-slot-resolution-map.json.

templateRows.headline: Ingress — planet enters a sign
templateRows.summary: Sky: a planet changes signs.
templateRows.body: {{planet}} enters {{sign}}.

templateRows.headline: Retrograde — planet turns retrograde
templateRows.summary: Sky: a planet stations retrograde.
templateRows.body: {{planet}} turns retrograde in {{sign}}.

templateRows.headline: Retrograde — planet turns direct
templateRows.summary: Sky: a planet stations direct.
templateRows.body: {{planet}} turns direct in {{sign}}. What stalled around {{planetTopic}} starts moving again, slowly at first. Begin applying what the review made clearer.

templateRows.headline: Retrograde — shadow period
templateRows.summary: Sky: pre/post retrograde shadow.
templateRows.body: {{planet}} is in its retrograde shadow in {{sign}}. The review around {{planetTopic}} is either warming up or settling. Give it room before calling anything final.

templateRows.headline: Retrograde back into previous sign
templateRows.summary: Sky: a retrograde planet crosses back into the prior sign.
templateRows.body: {{planet}} retrogrades back into {{sign}}. It revisits {{signStyle}} ground it already crossed, so {{planetTopic}} themes from that earlier stretch resurface for a second look.

templateRows.headline: Sky aspect — two planets (any type)
templateRows.summary: Sky: two planets in aspect now. Aspect type flavor comes from aspect-verb / aspect-feel.
templateRows.body: {{planetA}} is {{aspectAdj}} {{planetB}} in the sky right now. Watch where {{planetATopic}} and {{planetBTopic}} show up in the same conversation, decision, delay, or reaction.

templateRows.headline: Sky aspect — short row
templateRows.summary: Sky: compact aspect row for lists.
templateRows.body: {{planetA}} {{aspect}} {{planetB}}: {{aspectFeel}}.

templateRows.headline: Natal placement — planet in sign
templateRows.summary: You/Friends: sign section.
templateRows.body: {{possessive}} {{planet}} is in {{sign}}. This placement describes how {{planet}} works through {{sign}} qualities in the chart.

templateRows.headline: Natal placement — planet in house
templateRows.summary: You/Friends: house section.
templateRows.body: {{possessive}} {{planet}} is in the {{house}} house. This places {{planet}} in the area of {{houseLifeArea}}, where the placement becomes part of daily life.

templateRows.headline: Natal angle — Ascendant/MC/etc in a sign
templateRows.summary: You/Friends: an angle (Ascendant, MC, DC, IC) in a sign.
templateRows.body: {{possessive}} {{angle}} is in {{sign}}.

templateRows.headline: Natal ruler bridge — follow the sign's ruler
templateRows.summary: You/Friends: explains and follows a sign's ruling planet to its placement.
templateRows.body: {{sign}} answers to {{ruler}} here. With {{ruler}} in {{rulerSign}} in the {{rulerHouse}} house, the placement keeps developing through decisions and responsibilities in {{rulerHouseLifeArea}}.

templateRows.headline: Natal ruler bridge — chart ruler (Ascendant)
templateRows.summary: You/Friends: chart-ruler version for the Ascendant.
templateRows.body: Because the Ascendant is {{sign}}, {{ruler}} is the chart ruler. With {{ruler}} in {{rulerSign}} in the {{rulerHouse}} house, the chart keeps returning to decisions and responsibilities in {{rulerHouseLifeArea}}.

templateRows.headline: Natal synthesis — ties the placement together
templateRows.summary: You/Friends: closing synthesis of planet + sign + house.
templateRows.body: {{possessive}} {{planet}} is in {{sign}} in the {{house}} house. Together, the sign and house point to {{planetTopic}} in the area of {{houseLifeArea}}.

templateRows.headline: Natal aspect — two natal planets (any type)
templateRows.summary: You/Friends: aspect between two natal planets. Type flavor from aspect-verb / aspect-feel.
templateRows.body: {{possessive}} {{planetA}} is {{aspectAdj}} {{planetB}}, linking {{planetATopic}} with {{planetBTopic}}. It plays as {{aspectFeel}}, shaping how these two parts of the chart move together.

templateRows.headline: Transit — transiting planet to a natal point
templateRows.summary: You: a transiting planet aspects a natal planet. Timing, not permanent.
templateRows.body: Right now {{transitPlanet}} is {{aspectAdj}} your natal {{natalPoint}}. You may notice more activity around {{transitPlanetTopic}} and {{natalPointTopic}} while this contact is active.

templateRows.headline: Transit — transiting planet through a natal house
templateRows.summary: You: a transiting planet moves through a natal house.
templateRows.body: {{transitPlanet}} is moving through your {{house}} house. That puts {{transitPlanetTopic}} to work in the area of {{houseLifeArea}} for this stretch. Notice what comes up there.

templateRows.headline: Transit — transiting planet to an angle
templateRows.summary: You: a transiting planet aspects an angle (Ascendant/MC/etc).
templateRows.body: {{transitPlanet}} is {{aspectAdj}} your {{angle}}, bringing {{transitPlanetTopic}} to {{angleTopic}}. It plays as {{aspectFeel}}. This tends to be a visible, felt transit while it is close.

templateRows.headline: Daily timing — the main transit today
templateRows.summary: You: the day's headline timing.
templateRows.body: Today's main timing is {{activeTransit}}. It is active around {{window}}, so line up what matters with it rather than pushing against it.

templateRows.headline: Synastry — one person's planet to another's
templateRows.summary: Friends: person A's planet aspects person B's planet.
templateRows.body: {{personAPossessive}} {{planetA}} is {{aspectAdj}} {{personBPossessive}} {{planetB}}, bringing {{personAPossessive}} {{planetATopic}} together with {{personBPossessive}} {{planetBTopic}}. Between you it plays as {{aspectFeel}}.

templateRows.headline: Composite — aspect in the relationship chart
templateRows.summary: Friends: an aspect in the composite (relationship) chart.
templateRows.body: In the composite chart, {{planetA}} is {{aspectAdj}} {{planetB}}, linking the relationship's {{planetATopic}} with {{planetBTopic}}. It plays as {{aspectFeel}}.

templateRows.headline: Composite — planet in sign in the relationship chart
templateRows.summary: Friends: a composite planet placement.
templateRows.body: In the composite chart, {{planet}} in {{sign}} describes how the relationship carries {{planetTopic}} through a {{signStyle}} style. In the {{house}} house, that pattern tends to show up through {{houseLifeArea}}.

templateRows.headline: Synastry — one person's planet in the other's house
templateRows.summary: Friends: house overlay (directional; the reverse is its own row).
templateRows.body: {{personAPossessive}} {{planet}} lands in {{personBPossessive}} {{house}} house.

templateRows.headline: Synastry — a transit touching the relationship
templateRows.summary: Friends: current timing acting on the bond.
templateRows.body: Right now {{activeTransit}} is touching the relationship. It brings {{transitPlanetTopic}} to the surface between you around {{window}}.

templateRows.headline: Synastry — shared same-planet contact (mutual)
templateRows.summary: Friends: the mutual, both-directions same-planet case.
templateRows.body: {{personA}} and {{personB}} share a {{planet}} contact, so {{planetTopic}} runs in both directions at once. It is mutual: each of you can recognize it through the other, which can amplify or mirror it.

templateRows.headline: Friends circle — shared theme across a group
templateRows.summary: Friends: repeated timing across multiple charts.
templateRows.body: More than one person in this group is moving through {{topic}} right now. Same theme, different stories: one may encounter it through a conversation, another through a decision or a boundary. This is a shared timing pattern, not an identical experience.

templateRows.headline: Sky placement — planet currently in a sign (collective)
templateRows.summary: Sky: a planet's current sign placement, collective weather.
templateRows.body: {{planet}} is in {{sign}}, so the {{planet}} theme of {{planetTopic}} is active in a {{signStyle}} way. This transit can make that theme easier to notice in conversations, decisions, delays, or reactions around the room. Treat it as weather, not a verdict: name the signal, keep the response proportionate, and choose the next practical response.

templateRows.headline: Sky placement — planet retrograde in a sign
templateRows.summary: Sky: current placement when the planet is retrograde.
templateRows.body: {{planet}} is retrograde in {{sign}}, so the {{planet}} theme of {{planetTopic}} is being reviewed in a {{signStyle}} way. This is not a command to force an answer; it is a chance to notice what keeps returning, what needs revision, and what is not ready to be finalized yet.
